g.text: Okay, let's start. Goal for today is the rollout plan for the new
• Pilot of the new intake form at two clinics cut time per
We finished the pilot with two clinics. Average time per form
dropped from nine minutes to four.
• FHIR export date bug (local time) was fixed on Tuesday.
Nice. Any problems with the FHIR export?
One. Dates came through in local time, we fixed it on Tuesday.
• Rollout waits for the security sign-off.
From the security side we still need the data flow diagram before
• Daniel: data flow diagram by Friday.
Can you have that by Friday, Daniel?
• Priya: security sign-off early next week.
Yes, Friday works. I'll share it in the channel.
Then I can sign off early next week.
Great. Next topic: training for the front desk staff.
